source_scope: All recursive **/*.asm files in the extract; recognized literal scene-flag COP operands, calls whose target is flag_helpers.*, and explicit $eventFlags/$wramFlags symbol references.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: diamond_mine_laborer_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Possible event-flag indices selected by spawned Diamond Mine laborer actor parameters and the actor's lookup table.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: Only rows for `dm3F_laborer` actually spawned in `scene_actors.asm` are included. The actor parameter decodes to the byte-table X index; `extracted/diamond_mine/mine_main/dm3F_laborer.asm` uses that index to select a flag byte from `extracted/diamond_mine/mine_main/dm3F_laborer.asm`, then calls `TestFlagRaw / SetFlagRaw`. Unspawned entries in the actor's local table are excluded.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: necklace_stone_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Possible event-flag indices selected by spawned necklace-stone actor parameters and the actor's lookup table.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: Only rows for `gw82_necklace_stone` actually spawned in `scene_actors.asm` are included. The actor parameter decodes to the byte-table X index; `extracted/great_wall/gw82_necklace_stone.asm` uses that index to select a flag byte from `extracted/great_wall/gw82_necklace_stone.asm`, then calls `TestFlagRaw / SetFlagRaw`. Unspawned entries in the actor's local table are excluded.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: statue_reward_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Possible event-flag indices selected from the statue-reward table.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The selected four-byte `statue-reward` row supplies the raw event-flag index to the claim test and flag set.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: enemy_clear_reward_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Possible event-flag indices used for per-scene enemy-clear reward/reveal state.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The helper adds `$0300` to a scene index; nonzero table rows bound scenes with configured enemy-clear reward behavior.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: boss_reward_wram_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: WRAM indices selected by the matched boss-reward range row.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The caller matches the current scene to a boss-reward row; its row number is masked to 0-7 before `$0100` is added.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: barrier_chest_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Possible event-flag indices referenced by table-driven barrier and chest records.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The callers read the fourth record byte, mask it to seven bits, and pass it to the `$0200` helper.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: hidden_red_jewel_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The spawned actor parameter is decoded by the actor engine, then the actor-specific caller transform and helper offset select the index.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: dark_space_portal_death_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The spawned actor parameter is decoded by the actor engine, then the actor-specific caller transform and helper offset select the index.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: falling_orb_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The spawned actor parameter is decoded by the actor engine, then the actor-specific caller transform and helper offset select the index.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: floor_button_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The spawned actor parameter is decoded by the actor engine, then the actor-specific caller transform and helper offset select the index.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: gold_tile_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: The spawned actor parameter is decoded by the actor engine, then the actor-specific caller transform and helper offset select the index.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: enemy_death_action_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Event flags used to guard enemy death actions; zero-valued death-action indices are skipped by callers.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: Enemy-spawn rows supply the death-action index, actor execution stores it, and the helper adds `$0100`.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: dungeon_kill_wram_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Possible WRAM indices set when a nonzero enemy number is defeated and tested to suppress defeated enemies on later scene loads.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: Enemy-spawn rows supply the enemy number; actor execution stores it, the dungeon-kill COP handler passes it directly to `SetWramFlag`, and scene loading tests the same index in `wramFlags`.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: wram_offset_constant_callers
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Fixed boss-actor WRAM flag inputs observed at call sites; each helper masks the literal input to its low three bits.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: Each candidate pairs the immediate `LDA` input with its `TestWramFlag_Offset100` call; the helper masks the input with `$0007` and adds `$0100`.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: wram_offset_helper_domain
dynamic_helper_traces.description: The offset WRAM helper family can address exactly indices `$0100-$0107` after masking its input.
dynamic_helper_traces.resolution_method: Helper implementation masks the caller value with `$0007`, then adds `$0100`.

dynamic_helper_traces.name: inventory_ability_flags
dynamic_helper_traces.description: Status-menu ability flags computed from the current character form and selected ability slot.

unresolved_dynamic_helper_inputs.reason: The flag index is read from a runtime scene-script stream; this static extract does not identify a bounded set of operands for this command.
